charts.name: served
charts.title: How the site is served
charts.caption: How the site is served
charts.alt: Flow diagram of how birchdesignlab.com is served. Page requests go to Cloudflare Static Assets, which serves the built site or its 404 page, while form and beacon posts go to the Worker, which checks a honeypot, a rate limit, validation and a daily cap before sending email and holds failed sends in KV for a daily cron to retry.

charts.title: Repository map
charts.caption: Repository map
charts.alt: Tree of the repository. The root holds src, worker, tests, scripts, docs, share, assets, social, attic, .claude and public, and src, scripts and docs each branch into their main subfolders.

charts.name: lab-specimens
charts.title: The Lab: specimens
charts.caption: The Lab: specimens
charts.alt: How a Lab entry becomes pages. A Markdown file in src/content/lab is checked by the schema in lab-schema.ts, which feeds the Lab index and the detail page, the detail page also draws on the experiment and study registries, and a prebuild script renders its share card.

charts.name: portal-schools
charts.title: The Portal: design schools
charts.caption: The Portal: design schools
charts.alt: The seven design schools of the Portal side by side, each shown in its own real colours and display face with the same wordmark and the same shared sentence, above the files that make a school: shared copy and paths, the Portal runtime and switcher, one school's folder, its route and the guards.

charts.name: build-deploy
charts.title: Build, verify and deploy
charts.caption: Build, verify and deploy
charts.alt: Pipeline from a feature branch to production. npm run verify runs unit tests, type checks, the build and the built output tests, a pull request then needs a green CI check before merging, and Cloudflare Workers Builds builds and deploys birchdesignlab.com.

charts.name: harness
charts.title: The Claude Code harness
charts.caption: The Claude Code harness
charts.alt: Flow of one workflow task. A brief goes to an implementer, a Haiku seat verifies the head, and an Opus critic, a Sonnet verifier and a Sonnet gate review in parallel, then findings route to a fixer, a studio stop for taste calls, a deferred minors ledger, a parked state, or completion.
